head.note: head disc incl. stripes, face, cheek, bottom band; ear (in front) and tuft (outside the fitted head ellipse) removed; collar boundary = brown colour edge.

tuft.note: head-component pixels outside the head ellipse in the tuft window (x478-700, y<205), ear excluded.

earNear.note: inside the ellipse fitted to the ear's visible silhouette (vs background / dark head stripe); ear is in front of the head stripe; incl. inner oval and lower-rim crescent.

torso.note: body incl. collar band, collar-shadow band, belly; bounded by arm (step-1 layer), tail (back edge), hip cut and far leg colour edge.

pendant.note: acorn only (olive cap/stem + mint nut + highlights).

armNear.note: step-1 arm layer, alpha >= 128 (v2: forward, over the cream belly).

armFar.note: step-1 far-arm layer alpha >= 128 where the step-1 image without the far arm is background (the far arm is behind the body and the acorn).

legNear.note: below the hip cut polyline LEG_CUT (belly-bottom contour continued to the back silhouette).

legFar.note: shade-coloured leg below the belly (colour edge vs torso tan/cream).

tail.note: left of the torso back edge (first non-fur pixel walking left, per row).

not_visible.earFar: hidden behind the head in cand3
